title: Number one fans only — outdoor headline
slide_intent: Use scale and weight to give a short message a clear leading voice at a distance.
strategic_value: The broad rounded headline can make O2 Priority’s entertainment message feel direct while the blue imagery preserves brand continuity.
demonstration: A wide outdoor poster places a large white Number one fans only headline over blue-tinted crowd imagery, with a small O2 mark above and supporting copy below.
practical_value: Reserve the strongest scale for the primary phrase and test whether the image supports rather than obscures it.

content_islands.name: Blue crowd background
content_islands.spec: Fill the wide poster with a crowd image unified by blue tones.

content_islands.name: Headline hierarchy
content_islands.spec: Center the small O2 mark above the oversized white headline and place a two-line supporting message near the bottom.

reference_purposes.Expression: The headline displays the rounded, heavy type character at large scale.
reference_purposes.Application: The typography is demonstrated on a wide outdoor advertisement with subordinate brand and offer copy.
